title: SM Current Reference Generator
text: Synchronous machine current reference generator, 3 inputs, 3 outputs; {Nominal dc-link voltage (V)} sets the rated DC voltage, {Maximum power (W)} sets the maximum power, {Maximum torque (N*m)} sets the maximum torque, {Maximum field current (A)} sets the maximum field current, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time, {Current references} sets the current reference strategy Zero d-axis, {Torque constant (N*m/A)}, {Mechanical speed vector, wMechanical (rpm)} sets the rotor speed lookup vector, {Torque reference vector, TqRef (N*m)} sets the torque reference lookup vector, {DC-link voltage vector, Vdc (V)} sets the dC-link voltage lookup vector, {D-axis current reference matrix, id(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc), (A)} sets the reference d-axis current values zeros, {Q-axis current reference matrix, iq(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc), (A)} sets the reference q-axis current values zeros and {Field current reference matrix, iq(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc), (A)} sets the reference field current values zeros. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Nominal dc-link voltage (V)
params.values: Rated DC voltage 300 V (default) | positive number

params.name: Maximum field current (A)
params.values: Maximum field current 25 A (default) | positive number

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Block sample time -1 (default) | -1 or positive number

params.name: Current references
params.values: Current reference strategy Zero d-axis control (default) | Lookup-table based

params.name: Mechanical speed vector, wMechanical (rpm)
params.values: Rotor speed lookup vector [0, 3000] (default) | positive monotonically increasing vector

params.name: Torque reference vector, TqRef (N*m)
params.values: Torque reference lookup vector [-100, 0, 100] (default) | positive monotonically increasing vector

params.name: DC-link voltage vector, Vdc (V)
params.values: DC-link voltage lookup vector [300, 350] (default) | positive monotonically increasing vector

params.name: D-axis current reference matrix, id(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc), (A)
params.values: Reference d-axis current values zeros(2,3,2) (default) | real matrix

params.name: Q-axis current reference matrix, iq(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc), (A)
params.values: Reference q-axis current values zeros(2,3,2) (default) | real matrix

params.name: Field current reference matrix, iq(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc), (A)
params.values: Reference field current values zeros(2,3,2) (default) | real matrix
